title: BERIDA ZAINAB KHADI HAI SHAAM KA DARBAR HAI
body:
Aalame ghurbat me Aale Ahmed-e Muatar hai
Ab na lashkar hai na Abbase Alambardar hai
Haay kya badli huwi ab waqt ki raftar hai
Saamne rakha huwa Farge Shahe Abrar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm hai kursi nashi'n Kunba Nabi ka hai khada
Aur ek Bimar hai zanjeer me Jakda huwa
Hain rasan me Sabke shaane aur Sakina ka Gala
Haay Bachchi ke liye ab saans lena baar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tasht me rakha huwa hai Baap ka Sar saamne
Saans rukti hai tadapti hai jo Knwahar saamne
Khoon me doobe huwe hain kitne manzar saamne
Kis qadar zakhmi Nigaahe Abide Bimar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham zada Maadar ki ankhon me andhera chha gaya
Noujawa'n Bete ka Sar darbar me laya gaya
Jaane Laila se ye manzar Kis tarah dekha gaya
Kaisi Ghurbat me Shabihe Ahmed-e Muatar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Ali Asghar ka Sar jaise koi Taaza kali
Maadare Beshir ki jis dam nazar Uspar padi
Godh me lekar Sulaane ki tamanna jaag uthi
Haath rassi me bandhe hain Maa bohut lachar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Har ghadi Nazro'n keaage ek Qayamat hai nai
Sar pa Bhai ke Bahan ki hai nazar thehri huwi
Hont wo Shabbir ke aur daste zalim me chhadi
Ye Bahan ke Dil pa ek chalti huwi talwar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisa kaise dukh sahe darbar me Hamsheer ne
Gardan-e Bimar ko zakhmi kiya zanjeer ne
Apni Ankhen bandh karli hain Sare Shabbir ne
Bandh aankhon me magar ek hasrate Deedaar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aata hai Madine se safar ka wo sama
Tha wo Abbase Jari Ahle Haram ka Paasba'n
Sar parasti ko Hussain Ibne Ali Zehra ki Jaa'n
Abto ghurbat hamsafar hai rasta dushwaar hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Paasba'n baaqi nahi'n koi nahi'n ab Aasra
Fatima ki Betiyon par waqt kaisa aagaya
Dil yehi kehta hai Akhtar ab Ali ko de'n Sada
Aapki Beti Ko Moula Ek Rida Darkaar Hai
<<MINI>>
Berida Zainab Khadi hai shaam ka darbar hai
author: Akhtar Zaidi
